integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the positive-genus threshold, the exceptional genus-zero Arf condition, and the topological Levine-Tristram signature bound. The bundled finite check covers only the ceiling lemma.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to knots K with H_1(Sigma_d(K))=0, exactly the domain of the source's exact simple-genus formula. It gives a stability bound, not a converse or sharpness statement.
title: Simple relative genus is 1-Lipschitz under topological concordance distance
